question: In February 2023, PARAKH became the First National Assessment Regulator. What does R stand for in PARAKH?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Review**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PARAKH** stands for **Performance Assessment, Review, and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development**.
 
• In **February 2023**, PARAKH was established as the first national assessment regulator in India.
 
• The initiative aims to **standardize and improve the quality of assessments** across various educational boards in India.
 
• PARAKH will set norms, standards, and guidelines for student assessment and evaluation for all recognized school boards across the country.
 
• The regulator will also ensure the equivalence of academic standards among different boards, thereby promoting uniformity in assessments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The establishment of PARAKH is part of the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which emphasizes the need for a holistic, multi-disciplinary approach to education.
 
• NEP 2020 aims to **transform India's education system by 2040**, making it more inclusive, flexible, and aligned with the needs of the 21st century.
 
• PARAKH will also play a crucial role in the assessment reforms proposed by NEP 2020, including competency-based assessment and reducing the emphasis on rote learning.
 
• The regulator will work towards creating a more balanced and integrated assessment system that evaluates students' understanding, skills, and competencies.
